summary: The opposition's chamber leader says the address took up ideas their party raised first.
realLife: Two legislative leaders of the party out of power, in different states and years, said the governor's speech or plans repeated what their side had pushed or passed earlier, one adding that the governor had vetoed those ideas before and another saying the governor had read the last election and the polls.
sources: WXXI News / WRVO (Rochester and central New York), 'State Republicans react to Hochul's State of the State Address', January 14, 2025: https://www.wxxinews.org/2025-01-14/state-republicans-react-to-hochuls-state-of-the-state-address
